help.intro: Hello **{user}**, I'm **{bot}**. A Rich Quality Discord Music Bot. Support Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music & Others. Find out what I can do using commands below:

play.optionQuery: Provide a song name or url
play.noResults: No results found for your query.

skip.emptyQueue: Queue is empty. Skip not possible.

loop.off: Loop mode has been set to `off`.
loop.song: Loop mode has been set to `song`.
loop.queue: Loop mode has been set to `queue`.

shuffle.emptyQueue: Queue is empty. Shuffle not possible.
shuffle.onlyOneSong: Only one song in queue. Shuffle not possible.

seek.notSeekable: The current song is not seekable.
seek.timeExceeds: Time is greater than the duration of the song.

remove.description: Remove a song from the queue
remove.invalidPosition: Position is greater than the total songs in the queue.

lyric.description: Get the lyric of the current song
lyric.notFound: No lyrics found. Please try again later.
lyric.title: {bot} Lyrics

autoplay.notSupported: {status}. Autoplay mode can only be used with YouTube.
autoplay.currentNotSupported: The current song platform is not supported
autoplay.lastNotSupported: The last queue platform is not supported

events.queueEmpty: The queue is empty. You can disable this by using `247` command.
events.trackError: Song got an error. Skipping to the next song...
events.trackErrorEmpty: Song got an error and the queue is empty. Stopping the player...
events.trackStuck: Song got stuck. Skipping to the next song...
events.trackStuckEmpty: Song got stuck and the queue is empty. Stopping the player...
events.playerException: Error while playing. Skipping to the next song...
events.playerExceptionEmpty: Error while playing and the queue is empty. Stopping the player...
events.inactivityDisconnect: Disconnecting from the voice channel due to inactivity. You can disable this by using `247` command.
